caption: The drawing depicts a single hammer with a wooden handle rendered in shades of light brown and darker brown accents to indicate wood grain and form. The hammer's head is metallic, colored in a grayish tone with a slight sheen, and has a branding face that is shaped with a star-like pattern, with the number "5" visible in its center. The hammer head appears to be securely fitted to the handle and is shown at a diagonal angle across the page. The background is plain and beige in color. There is a red circular stamp with a signature in the bottom left and a small group of brownish stains in the upper left. Handwritten black text near the center of the page reads: "1840 BRANDING HAMMER FOR SYRUP & MOLASSES KEGS,".
title: Branding Hammer
